title: Research: partitioned independent-walks 8q priced obstruction (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Freestanding `#840`-style priced obstruction under [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898) at `(b,a,x)=(38,2,2)`. Names one new dirt-legal readout alphabet at `Q=8`: two restored walks with distinct slot lists, independent dirt, and dual even-parity readout. Answers open question 2 of [#2840](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2840): does any other priced alphabet undercut tariff `436` at eight queries after a complete dirty bill?

| Dual schedule | Covering pairs | Exact min R | Tariff floor (X≥0) | Undercuts 436? |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Same-walk even-subset (#2677) | — | ≥74 | ≥452 at X=0 | no |
| Partition `(2,6)` | **3916416** | **92** | **≥488** | **no** |
| Partition `(3,5)` | **10416000** | **98** | **≥500** | **no** |
| Partition `(4,4)` | **14165760** | **100** | **≥504** | **no** |

Global covering minimum is `R=92` on `(2,6)` only. Abstract tariff `38·8+2·92=488>436`. Length-1 components are not restored.

**Scoped obstruction / priced alphabet; no new kappa.** Leave-alone through [#2846](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2846) / [#2840](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2840) / [#2779](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2779) was not reopened.

## Result

Package: `research/independent-walks-8q-obstruction/`.
Tip: `379aaf8f413d47f3bcbc054e1e4bf3e2daed0ce9`.

Exact: partition min R **92** (tariff floor **488**); no undercut of 436.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-8q-obstruction/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/independent-walks-8q-obstruction/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-8q-obstruction/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-8q-obstruction/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/independent-walks-8q-obstruction
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_INDEPENDENT_WALKS_8Q_OBSTRUCTION partition_min_R=92 ... tariff_floor=488 ... answers_priced_alphabet_q8_oq no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_PARTITIONED_WALKS_8Q covering_26=3916416 covering_35=10416000 covering_44=14165760 ... tariff_floor=488 ... no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_WALKS_8Q_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/independent-walks-8q-obstruction outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()`; `-O` also passes.
